name: Agents First
description: The Agents First thesis website — a design framework for products built for both humans and AI agents. This card declares the agent-callable surfaces an agent will find here.

tools.name: create-agents-first
tools.description: Scaffold an Agents-First MCP server in one command — AGENTS.md, prep gate, Zod-typed state, retry-with-backoff helpers.

tools.name: agentsfirst-mcp
tools.description: MCP server that scores websites and codebases against the Agents First framework.

tools.name: agentsfirst_prep
tools.description: Pre-flight check — verifies rubric is loaded and principles are at the expected version.

tools.name: score_codebase
tools.description: Scores a local directory against the eight implementation principles. Returns score (0–100), adoption level (0–4), per-principle breakdown, anti-patterns flagged, top-3 next moves.

tools.name: score_website
tools.description: Scores a public URL on agent-readiness — discoverability, content accessibility, bot access control, agent capabilities.

tools.name: get_principle
tools.description: Returns the canonical text of one of the eight principles by slug.

tools.name: get_anti_pattern
tools.description: Returns the canonical definition of one of the seven anti-patterns by slug.

principles.description: Typed catalog of all eight implementation principles.

glossary.description: Typed catalog of all glossary terms — anti-patterns, principles, concepts, metrics.
